full_page.content:
1928, May
Fr. Solanus, Notebook NO. 4.
Page 24 Cont.
May 30th Mrs. E.J. Ackerman, 3009 Cadilac on way to Ford Hospital for operation for cancer of intestines stops at Monastery - unable to come in - is enrolled (one week before Thanksgiving 1926) Comes in To-day OKd
Mrs. Kumerow - N. Cath. 3215 Helen - peculiar effects of opera- tion 4 yrs. ago. Pray for him
Double - Goitre operation Deo Gr.
O'Connor - cancer
Page 25 June 6th Tim. Collins - Cancer of Stom. - Daghwood Ont. Sr. Cornelius - - insane
Jos F. Ryan - Cancer of Brain - 28 Hortens Union Town Pa. ... Barrett cancer .... stomach
Jeakle .... to avert a mixed marriage that seemingly must be un- happy
Thomas O'Brien, Windsor, inword Goitre - a wife & Family too ... helpless - 3 yrs. sick - June 25th, 1929 - reported O.K.
Philip Kretch - wife & 2 children - going out of his mind - pray for him
Mich Kenney 80, 5628 Comonwealth - Struck by Auto and got leg broken ..... Next Wed. cast to be removed - pray.
Kathleen Clarkson - Mary's sister 2534 Beals, 5 month in bed. Martel Coveny - losing mind
Mrs. Kaltz - Enemia - operation ??
.... cancer of Stomach feard ..... Has wife & 4 children - sick .... Flo P. 18 ... Cancer? ? ?
